A settled '''planet''' was traveled to by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] so he could collect the [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on criminal [[Bendu Fry]]. The [[Unidentified Twi'lek Jedi's son|son]] of a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Unidentified Twi'lek Jedi (father)|Jedi]] had a house here.<ref name="BBB" />

==Description==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was located near three astronomical objects, two of which were bright [[Color/Legends|yellow]] and one of which was red. From [[Realspace/Legends|space]], the world appeared blue with streaks of white.<ref name="BBB" /> The planet had a Type I [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]<ref name="Atmosphere" /> and a surface with plains covered in [[Grass/Legends|grass]] and [[Tree/Legends|trees]]. [[Cloud/Legends|Clouds]] formed within the planet's atmosphere.<ref name="BBB" />

==Locations==
The planet had many dome-shaped buildings, some of which had spires sticking out of them. One of these buildings was the house of the Twi'lek Jedi's son, located near several buildings like it. The world also contained a cantina.<ref name="BBB" />
